handedness.note: JSON field phonology.nombre_mans. SignBank Hand (RIGHT/LEFT/BOTH) is a different concept — store handedness code separately or extend schema.

entries.labelEn: Two-handed asymmetrical sing: the weak hand is the location in the sign
Two-handed sign in which both hands move but the hands are not mirrored in the sagittal plane. Their handshapes may differ
Two-handed symmetrical sing: both hands move and have the same handshape (note: the location may occasionally be non-identical)
